The acts: forced entry, forced undressing, attempted rape (could not insert), then oral insertion, manual and oral sexual assault, also assault causing light injury (rib fracture). So answer likely "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". Also maybe "故意伤害". In examples, they sometimes include both. For first example, they gave "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". That case similar: forced sexual assault with violence. So answer: 强制猥亵、侮辱妇女. Possibly also "故意伤害". But the pattern: they often list two crimes separated by semicolon. In example 1, they didn't include 故意伤害 even though there was injury. So likely just "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". Provide that.
